comment: More Flame Altars' own symbols, loaded when altars above 16 are switched on (Symbols.LoadShipped). AltarLimit is the game's altar-limit function: min(BalancingTable.altarsPerFlameLevel[flameLevel], 16), BalancingRegistry* in rcx, the Flame level in edx, the limit as a zero-extended u32 in eax (server 0x93dea0 / client 0xe96c80 on builds 26430253 / 26430625; identical bytes on both sides). altars.table is the table's offset of altarsPerFlameLevel (0x1b8). The Bases* symbols are PlayerBasesSystem functions for mergeBases (BaseMergeHook.cs), identical bytes on both sides: Rebuild(system, world) server 0x206510 / client 0x46dda0, Add(system, zone, index) 0x2072e0 / 0x46eb30, Contains(system, base, point) 0x2063a0 / 0x46dc30, Region(result, system, point) 0x208c60 / 0x470410, Point(result, system, point) 0x208fe0 / 0x470790, Water(result, boxes, system, point) 0x2083a0 / 0x46fbf0.
